description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Notify the Tourist Value Added Tax Refund Scheme
categorisation: This gazette notification primarily concerns the prescription of regulations under the Value Added Tax Act, specifically detailing the Tourist Value Added Tax Refund Scheme (TVRS). It involves the Minister exercising powers vested by the VAT Act to establish legal/regulatory frameworks for tax refunds, including specifications of goods, values, and refund calculations. While it names a Minister, the core content is regulatory (amending tax procedures) rather than about government personnel changes or structural reorganization, making it a Legal/Regulatory Gazette.
